question: Which additional arts complete this part of the enumeration addressed to the goddess?
premises: Ṣoḍaśī is identified as the sixteenth.
inference: The list continues with Rañjanī, Ṣoḍaśī, and Priyadarśanā, O lady of the gods.
plain_english: And indeed Rañjanī, O lady of the gods, Ṣoḍaśī, and Priyadarśanā.
